start.description: It specifies the start epoch if the type is 1, or the start date in the "YYYY-MM-DD" format (UTC timezone) if the type is 2

end.description: It specifies the end epoch if the type is 1, or the end date in the "YYYY-MM-DD" format (UTC timezone) if the type is 2

rollup_type.description:
Denotes how the requested rewards range is specified. Applicable values are:
-1 (epoch)
- 2 (date)

items.description: List of validator public keys to fetch the rewards breakdown. A maximum of 50 entries are allowed.

cl_rewards_breakdown.description:
Denotes whether the response should include a detailed consensus-layer (CL) rewards and penalties breakdown. The applicable values are: 
- true
- false (Default)
